# Define the voice

This file is step 1 of 2 of the skill `define-brand-voice`.

## Pages

- You define the voice of a brand or set the tone of a message. Read [Brand voice](../../../references/brand-voice.md).
- You set, describe, or test the tone of the content of a brand. Read [Tone of voice dimensions](../../../references/tone-of-voice-dimensions.md).
- You describe the personality that the voice expresses. Read [Brand identity prism](../../../references/brand-identity-prism.md).

## Directives

- Place the tone of the brand on each of the four tone dimensions. ^tone-on-four-dimensions
- Choose a position on the four tone dimensions before you choose tone words. ^dimensions-before-tone-words
- Limit the tone words of the brand to `5` or fewer. ^limit-tone-words
- List the anti-tone words: the tones that the brand avoids. ^list-anti-tone-words
- Before you use a funny tone, test its effect on trust with users. ^test-funny-tone-for-trust
- Describe the brand voice in `3` or `4` traits. ^voice-trait-count
- Name a trait to avoid for each voice trait, such as direct but not curt. ^trait-to-avoid
